title: Keep Crownspire Only
warm:
Keep Crownspire only meant [player_name] refused the second address and let Vivienne's absence wear one glass-tower name. Early thirties, she/her, across-the-hall neighbor—she folded the wider map shut while Nolan Greer watched and Detective Imani Brooks's homicide interest rose without a body. Four fates still open: willing leave, paid vanish, dead, staging. Keeping one name did not force any of them.

"Crownspire only," Nolan said, mid-forties holding, cufflinks clicking. "Soft alibi stays vertical. Soft also means Brooks may invent elsewhere if you won't." Wind sheer. Elevator chime. Unused perfume. Marcus Pell preferred the smaller geography. Rhea Quinn's slate stayed Crownspire-thin.

[player_name] did not invent a corpse by refusing the second address. She did not invent Milan. One name only proved she chose containment—and that Vivienne's cadence could still be method or coincidence inside a single building. Soft meant pliable evidence with tighter walls.

Across the hall. Black car. Wine rings. Hope and dread shared the folded map.

"Blow Crownspire open," Nolan murmured, "or name one fate thread from what stays inside the glass. Neither settles Vivienne. Both spend the kept name."

She catalogued Crownspire-only the way Brooks would: one address, no forced fate, soft still claimed. [player_name] felt the kept map watching her mouth, and understood that refusing elsewhere had already changed which soft she could still swear.
